label: VERIFIED
extraction: Delivery Gate configuration and blocking conditions. Configuration in quality-gate.py: RATIONALIZE (4 patterns: 'skip tests for now', 'pre-existing bug', 'will fix later', 'good enough for now'), LIBS (5 paths: growth-log/, decisions/log.md, output-index.md, ratings-tracker.md, tooling_capabilities.md), COMPLEX_THRESHOLD=3, DISK_WARN_GB=50, DISK_CRIT_GB=15. Blocking conditions: disk <15GB, >=3 learning libs stale, OR growth-log stale + complex task (>=3 edits). Rationalization patterns warning only (regex heuristics can false-positive). Install: cp quality-gate.py ~/.claude/scripts/; add Stop hook to ~/.claude/settings.json. Examples: simple session (1 edit) -> exit 0; complex task with learning captured -> exit 0; complex task no learning -> BLOCKED; low disk -> BLOCKED. Pair with self-audit for content quality verification.
